title: Recording: Medicine Jar, Letting Go, Venus And Mars (Reprise) by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

An overdub session for three songs on Wings’ Venus And Mars album took place on 6 February 1975.

Jimmy McCulloch added wah-wah guitar to ‘Medicine Jar’, and Joe English added cymbals to Geoff Britton’s drum part.

In the afternoon, Paul McCartney and McCulloch overdubbed more guitar to ‘Letting Go’, after which Paul and Linda McCartney and Denny Laine recorded backing vocals.

The final work of the day was on ‘Venus And Mars (Reprise)’. Paul McCartney added Mellotron and Minimoog synth parts, McCulloch recorded an acoustic guitar part, English played percussion, and Paul McCartney, Laine, McCulloch, and English all taped backing vocals, which were given an underwater effect.

During this session, John Lennon called the studio to inform McCartney that he would not be attending any of the New Orleans sessions, due to his reconciliation with Yoko Ono.
